decisions.reason: The accepted option explicitly changes the mint-success modal to expose manual post-mint transaction actions without opening automatic transaction prompts.

success_modal_transaction_actions.random_referral_finalization: manual separate transaction displayed only for no-code mints when a VRF requestId is detected

decisions.reason: The modal transaction-interaction decision does not change fiat wallet creation, custody, holdings, or access paths.
The decision does not change the Transak provider, fiat conversion flow, supported payment methods, or deferred lifecycle.
Separating optional post-mint transactions does not alter the mint price or mandatory primary-sale revenue allocation.
The accepted option concerns optional actions after mint success and does not change USDC approval or NFT-mint execution.
The accepted option does not change ETH-funded mint execution.
The decision does not change exact-output swapping, ETH consumption, shortfall handling, or excess refunds.
Post-mint tipping and random-referral actions do not alter the presentation or selection of mint payment methods.
The source accepts a success-modal interaction design but does not request any FAQ copy change.
The source decision does not change About-page content.
The decision does not change certificate delivery, contents, reading actions, or download links.

This Requirement governs commissions from valid code-used mints; the newly manual finalization action applies only to no-code random-referral awards and leaves code-used commission behavior unchanged.
